issues.title: Ingest Crawford County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $31,512,962 across 32 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($11,033,945), Highway Fund ($9,590,008), Jail & Law Enforcement (1/4 Cent Sales Tax) Fund ($3,756,023). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile ADEM - Sales Tax Public Safety (Sales Tax 40% Public Safety Fund)
issues.detail: Section 4 of the ordinance (p. 2) appropriates $46,000.00; Attachment "C" (p. 22) lists supplies $40,000 and capital outlay $3,000, total $43,000.00. Printed total is $46,000.00; the categories listed add to $43,000.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
